subject: Annual prepay kickoff: drawdowns & VAT uploads
body:
From: Sam Carter <sam.carter@bluebridge.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@bluebridge.com
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Annual prepay kickoff: drawdowns & VAT uploads
Attachments: BlueBridge_SOW_signed.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the onboarding call last week — great to get the team aligned. Per our discussion, BlueBridge is ready to activate the annual prepay commitment for $360k (USD) and we'd like to confirm the invoicing and first drawdown mechanics so we can wire the initial tranche next week. Key asks from finance: 

- One consolidated invoice for the full prepay + a provided amortization schedule (they prefer one invoice with a ledger reference).
- An initial drawdown/activation on 2028-05-22 for $90k, followed by monthly sweeps thereafter (dates TBD).
- Confirmation of VAT handling (we're EU/US hybrid; they need country-level tax evidence and a VAT-exempt treatment for our US entity if possible).

I've attached the signed SOW. Can you confirm the invoice format you need and whether Redwood will accept ACH (US) and SEPA (EU) rails? Also, what VAT evidence should we upload to satisfy your AP team?

Best,
Sam Carter
Head of Finance, BlueBridge Inc.
Sam.Carter@bluebridge.com
\

On Mon, 14 May 2028 at 13:02 Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Sam Carter <sam.carter@bluebridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 13:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Annual prepay kickoff: drawdowns & VAT uploads

Hi Sam — thanks, and congrats on getting the SOW signed. We're excited to get this live. Short answers up front: ACH and SEPA are fine; we can issue a single invoice and provide a ledger file for amortization. VAT: we'll need the buyer's VAT number (if EU) or a local tax exemption certificate for US entities — Karthik, marking you to advise on the evidence we need.

Next steps I propose:
- Karthik to share the invoice template, payment rails we accept, and the billing reference format.
- Redwood will issue the invoice dated 2028-05-21 to allow the 05-22 drawdown we discussed.
- Markus to confirm if we should collect country-level VAT evidence up front or accept post-pay uploads for the first sweep.

Sam — if you can drop the buyer tax IDs and preferred payment rail, we'll draft the invoice and DocuSign/transfer instructions today.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwood.com
\

-----Original Message-----
> From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
> To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>; Sam Carter <sam.carter@bluebridge.com>
> Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
> Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 09:00:00 -0400
> Subject: Re: Annual prepay kickoff: drawdowns & VAT uploads
> Attachments: Invoice_20280501.pdf (application/pdf)
>
> Hi all,
>
> Drafted the billing approach below — keeping it simple to match BlueBridge AP preferences: 
>
> 1) Invoice: single invoice for full committed amount ($360,000 USD) dated 2028-05-21. Invoice number RB-DB-98765-01.
> 2) Amortization ledger: CSV/ledger file (we'll upload to your shared Drive) that shows monthly consumption credits and remaining balance.
> 3) Drawdown schedule: initial drawdown (wire) on 2028-05-22 for $90,000; subsequent auto-sweeps on the 22nd of each month. If the 22nd falls on a weekend/holiday we will process the next business day.
> 4) Payment rails: ACH (US), SEPA (EU), and Wire (global). Please confirm beneficiary details for your finance team.
> 5) VAT: we can issue the invoice without VAT if you provide the buyer VAT number and supporting certificate; otherwise we'll include VAT by country rate and credit it back once evidence is provided.
>
> Sam — attached is a sample invoice (Invoice_20280501.pdf) to show layout. We'll generate the final invoice once we have the buyer tax IDs and preferred rail.
>
> Aisha — tagging Markus for the VAT flow question below.
>
> Thanks,
> Karthik
\

On Wed, 16 May 2028 at 16:45 Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Carter <sam.carter@bluebridge.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 May 2028 16:45:00 +0100
Subject: RE: Annual prepay kickoff: drawdowns & VAT uploads

Thanks — quick clarification on VAT: because BlueBridge is a hybrid entity (EU subsidiaries and a US HQ) we'll treat each drawdown regionally. Operational plan:

- Final invoice (RB-DB-98765-01) will include a line for gross amount and a country VAT breakdown (if we can't validate exemption).
- For immediate activation on 2028-05-22, allow the initial $90k to be processed with an "provisional" VAT status: we will record the payment and mark VAT pending until BlueBridge uploads the tax evidence. If evidence arrives within 30 days we will issue a credit note to remove VAT where applicable.
- Naomi, please confirm the automated credit-note cadence and whether AP can accept provisional payments against an outstanding VAT validation.

Aisha / Karthik — this provisional approach reduces delay for go-live while protecting tax compliance. Sam — please provide the buyer VAT IDs and point me to whichever country registration docs you have.

Markus Klein
Tax & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
\

On Wed, 16 May 2028 at 17:02 Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Carter <sam.carter@bluebridge.com>
Date: Wed, 16 May 2028 17:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Annual prepay kickoff: drawdowns & VAT uploads

All good on provisional treatment — AP will accept the first $90k on 2028-05-22 as a provisional sweep provided BlueBridge uploads the tax evidence to the shared Drive within 30 days. We will generate any credit notes within 5 business days of receiving valid evidence.

Sam — I've added the HubSpot deal and DocuSign link to your inbox (see links below). Please confirm beneficiary details (account number, BIC/IBAN for SEPA) and we will issue the final PDF invoice on 2028-05-21.

Naomi Feldman
Billing Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

Links:
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/DB-98765
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/XYZ-BlueBridge-SOW

----
Notes for internal ops:
- Action items:
  * Aisha: confirm wire/ACH instructions back to Sam by EOD 2028-05-16.
  * Karthik: prepare final invoice (RB-DB-98765-01) and attach amortization ledger.
  * Naomi: place provisional payment flag and configure credit-note template.
  * Markus: log VAT follow-up task (30-day evidence window) in the tax tracker.
